_comment: A GET .../pull response for an e2ee environment, field for field as apps/web
serves it. The shape is the web contract; the ciphertexts are not fabricated.
edkSealed is sealed-box/token-edk from e2ee-vectors.json verbatim, so it was
produced by the TypeScript implementation and opens to the EDK the
secret-value vectors encrypt under. Each secret's ciphertext, orgId,
environmentId, secretId and version come from those vectors unchanged.
ehkSealed is the one blob the vector file has no token-recipient entry for.
It was produced by cli/internal/e2ee, sealing value-hmac/ascii's EHK to the
same token public key under the ehk-grant AAD. Byte-compatibility of that
construction is what vectors_test.go proves; this file's job is the plumbing
above it — bundle to principal to plaintext.
STALE_KEY names a retired env_data_keys row, which is the shape a version
written before a rotation has. It must be reported as rotated away rather
